Package neqsim.process.engineering.model

Class EngineeringDiagramBalanceTable

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.model.EngineeringDiagramBalanceTable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EngineeringDiagramBalanceTable extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, deterministic mass and stream-enthalpy balance projection.

The projection consumes a governed EngineeringDiagramStreamTable plus explicit boundary assignments. It never guesses whether a stream is an inlet or outlet. Stream enthalpy flow is calculated as mass flow times mass-specific enthalpy. The result therefore excludes equipment heat duties and shaft work and is not a complete energy balance.
